description: POKT Network Intelligence. Eight read-only endpoints over Pocket Network's own Shannon chain state, each sourced live (no cached-forever constants) from Pocket's public GraphQL indexer and Cosmos LCD: POST /v1/pulse (network snapshot), /v1/tokenomics (live governance params), /v1/validators (LCD validator set with true bonded voting power), /v1/suppliers (staked suppliers, network-wide or per service), /v1/throughput (claimed vs. difficulty-estimated relay volume), /v1/applications (staked applications), /v1/service-demand (per-service supply/demand proxy), /v1/supplier-trust (deterministic 0-100 score for one operator id). Full request/response shapes: see the openapi spec in specs[] and the repo README. Every response is a single JSON object; bad input returns 4xx JSON.

rpc_types.backend_hint: pokt-network-intel HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/pulse, /v1/tokenomics, /v1/validators, /v1/suppliers, /v1/throughput, /v1/applications, /v1/service-demand, /v1/supplier-trust, and GET /v1/version, /v1/health are expected. Every response is a JSON object; bad input returns 4xx with a JSON error object, never HTML or plain text.

specs.notes: Covers all eight resources in one document. TODO before MainNet staking: pin this to an immutable commit SHA in the path (not 'main') and add a sha256 of the exact bytes once frozen, per this repo's own README.

serving.backend: The pokt-network-intel Node.js HTTP server (no external dependencies) behind a RelayMiner, with the REST backend pointed at http://<container>:8080. No auth toward the backend; callers cannot send headers through the gateway. The backend itself calls out to Pocket's own public GraphQL indexer and Cosmos LCD on every request (short in-memory TTL cache, stale-on-error fallback) — it needs outbound HTTPS to data.pocket.network and sauron-api.infra.pocket.network (or the beta equivalents), nothing else.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service so a wrong backend cannot be staked under this id.

Functional probe: mint_ratio is a live governance parameter fetched from the tokenomics module on every call, so a matching shape proves the backend can reach and correctly parse the Cosmos LCD right now. The exact value is not asserted because it is a live parameter that changes by governance proposal, not a constant.

serving.notes: Suppliers should disable any local rate limiting for the RelayMiner's address. Request bodies are capped at 1 MiB (every resource here is a small JSON query) and responses are ordinarily a few KB. Backend timeout budget: keep well under the operator's configured relay_timeout (typically 10-30s); the backend itself applies an 8s timeout (POCKET_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS) to each upstream call with one retry, and serves the last good cached value (tagged stale) rather than blocking indefinitely on a slow upstream. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"]; see sage-service.yaml.
